The post-estimation contract

Source: vignettes/post-estimation-contract.Rmd
post-estimation-contract.Rmd

A fitted lm_robust object is handed to many functions estimatr did not write: coef(), predict(), confint(), anova(), hatvalues(), sandwich::vcovHC(), and dozens more. Some of these have estimatr methods, some fall through to a method written for lm, and some have no business running on a fit that does not store residuals or a QR decomposition. The post-estimation contract records, for every one of 71 probes on each of 10 fits, what estimatr promises the call will do. The table below is rendered from inst/contract/contract.csv, the same file the test suite reads, so the page cannot drift from what is checked.

The promises

Each cell carries exactly one promise:

code promise meaning
= agrees returns the same answer as the call on the reference fit (lm(), or ivreg::ivreg() for the IV fits), or on a stated reference
R refuses stops with estimatr’s own message saying the generic is not available for this fit
E errors stops, rather than return something that would mislead
~ returns returns a value, with no reference answer to hold it to
! known_wrong a recorded gap; the test fails if it starts agreeing, so a fix is entered here

Across the 710 cells: 326 agree, 90 refuse, 262 error, 32 return, 0 are known wrong, and 0 make no promise.

The test (tests/testthat/test_contract.R) runs each probe in a fresh R process holding estimatr and only the packages that probe needs, and runs the reference in a process that never loads estimatr. Isolation matters here: clubSandwich replaces estimatr’s bread() and model.frame() methods when it is loaded second, and performance registers a logLik() method for iv_robust, so a probe run beside them measures them rather than estimatr.

What decides a cell

One rule assigns every promise, so that the next generic is placed by it rather than by taste.

  • A cell agrees wherever lm() or ivreg::ivreg() answers the same call and the fit stores what the answer needs. Where estimatr has a method, it returns that answer; where it has none, the fall-through must already be right.
  • A cell refuses where the reference answers but the fit cannot, and the message names what the fit lacks: difference_in_means() and horvitz_thompson() store no residuals and no design, a fixed_effects fit does not store its absorbed design, a fit with several outcomes has one residual matrix for them all, and case-deletion diagnostics need leave-one-out refits that are not computed. A refusal replaces a NULL, a wrong number, or an unhelpful error with a sentence; it never replaces a working answer.
  • A cell errors where no package should answer. logLik(), AIC(), and BIC() are the case to know: the estimators assume no distribution, and estimatr registers no logLik() on any class, because performance registers one for iv_robust() fits and a refusal on lm_robust() fits alone would make the answer depend on which package loaded last. The rest are generics that read internals an estimatr fit does not have, such as qr(), effects(), alias(), and anova().
  • A cell returns only on horvitz_thompson(), which has no reference fit.

The fits

All ten are fit to one simulated dataset of 60 rows with a binary treatment z, a covariate x, a binary instrument iv, ten clusters g, a four-level factor f, weights w (three of them zero), and a second outcome y2.

fit estimatr call reference
lm_plain lm_robust(y ~ x + z, d) lm(y ~ x + z, d)
lm_wt0 lm_robust(y ~ x + z, d, weights = w) lm(y ~ x + z, d, weights = w)
lm_cl lm_robust(y ~ x + z, d, clusters = g) lm(y ~ x + z, d)
lm_fe lm_robust(y ~ x + z, d, fixed_effects = ~f) lm(y ~ x + z + f, d)
lm_mv lm_robust(cbind(y, y2) ~ x + z, d) lm(cbind(y, y2) ~ x + z, d)
lm_lin lm_lin(y ~ z, ~x, d) lm(y ~ z + x_c + z:x_c, d)
iv_plain iv_robust(y ~ z + x \| iv + x, d) ivreg::ivreg(y ~ z + x \| iv + x, data = d)
iv_cl iv_robust(y ~ z + x \| iv + x, d, clusters = g) ivreg::ivreg(y ~ z + x \| iv + x, data = d)
dim difference_in_means(y ~ z, d) lm(y ~ z, d)
ht horvitz_thompson(y ~ z, d, condition_prs = ...) none

The reference fits report classical variances, so a cell that concerns a variance, a standard error, or an interval refers instead to the variance estimatr reports by default: sandwich::vcovHC(ref, type = "HC2"), or clubSandwich::vcovCR(ref, type = "CR2") with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom for the clustered fits. lm_wt0’s variances refer to the same regression on its positive-weight rows, because sandwich counts zero-weight rows as observations. x_c is x centered, as lm_lin() centers it. dim and ht equal a regression on z only where a row says so.

Why each refusal

A refusal names what the fit lacks. These are the messages, and the cells that carry them:

message cells fits
bread() is not available bread, sandwich lm_fe, lm_mv
cooks.distance() is not available cooks.distance lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
deviance() is not available deviance, sigma lm_mv
dfbeta() is not available dfbeta lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
dfbetas() is not available dfbetas lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
estfun() is not available estfun, meat, vcovHC, vcovCL, vcovHAC, vcovOPG lm_fe, lm_mv
hatvalues() is not available hatvalues lm_fe, lm_mv
influence() is not available influence lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
rstandard() is not available rstandard lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
rstudent() is not available rstudent lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
Can’t set se.fit == TRUE with multivariate outcome predict lm_mv
Can’t set se.fit or interval with fixed_effects predict lm_fe
not built from a design matrix bread dim, ht
the estimator has no residuals df.residual dim
the estimator has no residuals or fitted values residuals, resid, fitted, fitted.values, deviance, sigma dim
the estimator is not built from a design matrix variable.names, labels dim
the rows used are not stored on the fit case.names dim

Decisions

Some cells could reasonably have gone either way: whether df.residual() reports N - K or the cluster-adjusted degrees of freedom, whether logLik() on a robust fit should exist at all. Where a cell’s promise was a choice rather than a consequence, the maintainer’s decision is recorded beside it:

decision promise generics fits
refused refuses residuals, resid, fitted, fitted.values, deviance, sigma, case.names, variable.names, labels dim
multi-outcome refused refuses predict, deviance, sigma, hatvalues, bread, estfun, meat, sandwich, vcovHC, vcovCL, vcovHAC, vcovOPG lm_mv
per outcome, as lm() reports them agrees confint, summary lm_mv
N - K; consumers get upstream fixes agrees df.residual lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
refused; the tests use fit$df refuses df.residual dim
N - K; consumers get upstream fixes returns df.residual ht
implement with lm’s meaning agrees deviance, sigma lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
no logLik() method on any class; performance registers one for iv_robust, so a refusal on lm_robust alone made AIC(fit) depend on load order errors logLik, AIC, BIC, extractAIC lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
terms() full (lm_lin translated), formula() the call’s agrees formula lm_fe, lm_lin
terms() full (lm_lin translated), formula() the call’s agrees terms, labels lm_fe
terms() full (lm_lin translated), formula() the call’s returns terms, labels lm_lin
the regressors, as ivreg’s terms() default to agrees terms iv_plain, iv_cl
implement with lm’s meaning agrees case.names lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_lin
implement with lm’s meaning; the reference has no case.names() of its own agrees case.names lm_mv, iv_plain, iv_cl
implement with lm’s meaning agrees labels lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, iv_plain, iv_cl
implement with lm’s meaning agrees hatvalues lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
implement with lm’s meaning refuses hatvalues lm_fe
refuse case-deletion diagnostics refuses cooks.distance, influence, dfbeta, dfbetas, rstandard, rstudent lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
refuse case-deletion diagnostics errors cooks.distance, influence, dfbeta, dfbetas, rstandard, rstudent dim, ht
reaches extractAIC(), which has no method on any class errors add1 lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_mv
reaches extractAIC(), which has no method on any class errors drop1, step lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin
summary() carries sigma, as summary.lm() does agrees summary lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl
dim has no residual quantities; $ cannot refuse, so NULL is the promise agrees summary dim
not stored, as lm(model = FALSE); consumers fall back to model.frame() agrees $model lm_plain, lm_wt0, lm_cl, lm_fe, lm_mv, lm_lin, iv_plain, iv_cl, dim
